examples.text: Nawet z obolałą głową czuł wyśmienity zapach parzonej kawy oraz słodko-maślany posmak croissantów. Przełamał jeden z nich i powoli żuł, wpatrując się w gospodarza.
examples.translation: Even with a headache he sensed the delicious scent of the hot coffee and the sweet-buttery taste of the croissants. He broke one of them and slowly chewed it, contemplating his host.
examples.english: Even with a headache he sensed the delicious scent of the hot coffee and the sweet-buttery taste of the croissants. He broke one of them and slowly chewed it, contemplating his host.

examples.text: Okręt przełamał się na pół i natychmiast poszedł na dno.
examples.translation: The ship broke in half and immediately sank to the bottom.
examples.english: The ship broke in half and immediately sank to the bottom.

examples.text: - Na szczęście nasza armia utrzymuje pozycje. Przełamali je [Rosjanie] tylko w dwóch miastach - Kreminnej i innym mały miasteczku - dodał Daniłow.
examples.translation: "Fortunately, our army is holding its positions. [The Russians] have broken through them in only two places: Kreminna and another small town," added Danilov.
examples.english: "Fortunately, our army is holding its positions. [The Russians] have broken through them in only two places: Kreminna and another small town," added Danilov.

examples.text: - [...] Jak się ta bariera tolerancji [na zanieczyszczenie powietrza] przełamie, to organizm reaguje alergicznie – opowiada dr Dąbrowiecki.
examples.translation: "… When this barrier of tolerance [of air pollution] is broken down, then one's body reacts with an allergy," replies Dr. Dąbrowiecki.
examples.english: "… When this barrier of tolerance [of air pollution] is broken down, then one's body reacts with an allergy," replies Dr. Dąbrowiecki.

examples.text: Potrzebujemy prezydenta, który przełamie izolację Polski w Europie i odbuduje zaufanie instytucji europejskich.
examples.translation: We need a president who will break down Poland's isolation within Europe and rebuild the confidence of the European institutions.
examples.english: We need a president who will break down Poland's isolation within Europe and rebuild the confidence of the European institutions.

glosses: to find it in one's heart, to come to terms, to get to grips

examples.text: Carmody pokręcił głową. Był pewien, że przy takich akrobacjach jego sztuczny autorytet niechybnie ucierpi. Nie chciał się zwracać także o pomoc ani do Grega, ani do swoich goryli. Toczył wewnętrzną walkę, którą Greg obserwował spod oka. Wreszcie przełamał się; zdecydował, iż utrata poważania będzie go bolała bardziej niż śmierć, i zawrócił. - Wiesz, Greg - powiedział - ja chyba ... tego ... pojadę windą. Jak sądzisz...?
examples.translation: Carmody shook his head. He was sure that with such acrobatics, his artificial authority would suffer unavoidably. He also didn't want to turn to Greg or to his gorillas for help. He fought an inner fight, which Greg observed from the corner of his eye. Finally he made up his mind; he decided that the loss of respect would hurt him more than death, and he turned around. "You know, Greg," he said, "I think I'll ... well ... take the elevator. What do you think...?"

"You know, Greg," he said, "I think I'll ... well ... take the elevator. What do you think...?"

examples.text: Chłopak opowiada, że dopiero gdy poznał koleżanki bardzo zmotywowane, by mówić po walijsku i powiększać grupę osób używających w szkole tego języka, przełamał się i zaczął robić postępy.
examples.translation: A boy reports that it was only when he got to know female classmates who were highly motivated to speak Welsh and enlarge the group of people using that language in school that he got over himself and started to make progress.
examples.english: A boy reports that it was only when he got to know female classmates who were highly motivated to speak Welsh and enlarge the group of people using that language in school that he got over himself and started to make progress.

examples.text: To jest naturalne w narciarstwie zjazdowym i nie da się nic innego zrobić, niż przełamać się mentalnie.
examples.translation: This is natural in downhill skiing, and there is nothing to do besides coming to terms with it mentally.
examples.english: This is natural in downhill skiing, and there is nothing to do besides coming to terms with it mentally.
